##: Replay, the free offline AI audio tool from Weights (weights.com/replay) for voice conversion and stem separation.

The Download for Windows button is a redirect endpoint (www.weights.com/api/replay/download-url?platform=windows) that answers 302 with a presigned Cloudflare R2 URL valid for two hours, so it cannot be pinned. The app's own electron-updater uses the same bucket through updates-windows.weights.com (resources/app-update.yml: provider s3, bucket replay-updates-windows), and that host serves the object unsigned, so the manifest pins Replay-<version>-installer.exe there.
The pinned object is the published build: its SHA-512 equals the base64 sha512 in https://updates-windows.weights.com/latest.yml, and its size matches the size field (147102488).

The installer is electron-builder NSIS-3 Unicode (per-user, one-click): $PLUGINSDIR\app-64.7z holds the whole app flat, with Replay.exe at the root, and $R0 only carries 'Uninstall Replay.exe'. The installer script expands the payload into $dir and drops both folders.
Only x64 is published; there is no 32-bit or ARM build on the download page.
checkver reads latest.yml, which the vendor regenerates with every release.

autoupdate.hash is omitted because the feed publishes only a base64 SHA-512: Scoop splits a hash on ':' and hands the remainder to Get-FileHash, which compares hex digests, so the base64 value cannot be used as is. The Excavator recomputes the SHA-256 of the 140 MiB installer on update.
description: Offline AI audio tool for voice conversion and stem separation
notes: The NSIS stubs ($PLUGINSDIR and the bundled 'Uninstall Replay.exe') are dropped, so Scoop owns the uninstall.

Settings, recordings and the downloaded voice weights live under "$env:APPDATA\Replay\<appId>" (db.json, recordings, weights, train), and the updater cache under "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\replay-updater", so nothing needs to be persisted.

The bundled electron-updater is enabled. An in-app update runs the vendor installer, which creates a per-user copy outside the Scoop app directory instead of replacing it; run 'scoop install replay -f' afterwards to return to the packaged build.
weights.com and its update hosts do not resolve to the real servers from mainland China, so downloading needs a working proxy.
Voice conversion is GPU-accelerated when an NVIDIA card is present and considerably slower on CPU alone.
